claims.text: The models using α-entmax and 1.5-entmax achieve 75% and 90% of the training speed of the softmax model, respectively.
The adaptive model shows higher median confidence (95.9%) in attention weights compared to the softmax model (93.5%) and 1.5-entmax model (94.4%).
The adaptive model learns to combine sparse and dense attention, leading to improved performance over fixed α models.
